desc: Verify unique corner representation and cyclic perimeter ordering.
Find a concrete opposite-edge compression counterexample.
Investigate same-edge wraparound handling; no counterexample was found.
Exhaustively compare the current implementation with exact subset enumeration on small squares and randomized boundary subsets.
Prove correctness for same-edge, adjacent-edge, opposite-edge, and cyclic wraparound constraints.
Replace the per-start, per-selection `bisect_left` loop with next-pointer/binary-lifting optimization.
Stress-test runtime and memory for \(n \le 15{,}000\), \(k \le 25\), including low and high feasible distances.
Confirm sample-test verdict for the complete implementation.
If a proof gap or counterexample is found, replace the greedy feasibility routine with a provably correct alternative.
